readerCopy.headline: You are easier to notice right now.
readerCopy.body:
You may find people responding to you more quickly, inviting you in, or treating an idea you mention casually as something worth pursuing. An introduction can lead somewhere. A role you would normally overthink may feel possible enough to try. You may also feel more willing to take up space without rehearsing how everyone else will receive it first.

Jupiter crossing your Ascendant can make life feel larger because more is coming toward you and you are more willing to meet it. Enjoy the extra confidence, but do not promise every new person, plan, or opportunity a permanent place in your week. Let yourself grow into the larger version without turning every open door into another obligation.
doNotAssume: Do not assume a physical transformation, health event, fame, or that every new opportunity is beneficial.
